text: 总要图点什么吧？
en: You must be after something, surely?

text: 图你高龄产妇？
en: After your advanced maternal age?

text: 图你容貌快速衰老？
en: After your looks ageing fast?

text: 图你愿意为我花钱？
en: After your willingness to spend on me?

text: 图你提供情绪价值？
en: After your providing emotional value?

text: 承认吧，金钱对男人有多残酷，年龄对女人就有多残酷。
en: Admit it: money is as cruel to men as age is to women.

text: 各有各的苦，只是男人13岁就开始接触金钱对男人的残酷，女人往往要到了40岁了，男人不再愿意因为你是女的而带你玩或者让着你了，才开始知道现实的残酷。
en: Each has their own suffering; it is only that men encounter, from the age of 13, the cruelty of money towards men, whereas women often only come to know the cruelty of reality once they reach 40 — when men no longer wish to include them or humour them simply because they are women.

text: 女人，特别是从小就有点漂亮的女人，一直享受着一定的优待和特权，直到，40岁时，这些优待和特权基本就消失了，聪明的女人早早看清了，糊涂的女人40岁了才惊慌，并到处在问，这个世界怎么了？
en: Women, especially those who have been somewhat pretty since childhood, have always enjoyed certain preferential treatment and privilege; until, at 40, these privileges and special treatment have essentially vanished. The clever woman sees through it early, while the muddled woman is only alarmed at 40, and goes around asking: what has become of this world?

text: 可其实，世界基本规则没变，男人没钱开除人籍，女人40岁，如果还没钱，基本也差不多了，开除人籍！
en: Yet in truth the basic rules of the world have not changed: a man with no money is stripped of his humanity; a woman at 40, if she still has no money, is essentially the same — stripped of her humanity!

text: 这世上存在两种价值系统。
en: There exist two value systems in this world.

text: 物化或以人为本。
en: Objectification, or people-centredness.

text: 物化的体系是人类商品化，把人当作货架上商品去赤裸交易的市场。
en: The objectified system is the commodification of human beings — a market that treats people as goods on a shelf to be traded bare.

text: 追求的是在世俗标准答案下的客观价值，老公的标准答案是高富帅，老婆的标准答案是美丽温柔年轻辣妈，家庭的标准答案是有房有车儿女双全优秀。
en: What it pursues is objective value under secular standard answers: the standard answer for a husband is tall, rich and handsome; the standard answer for a wife is beautiful, gentle, young and a hot mum; the standard answer for a family is owning a house and car, with both a son and a daughter, all excellent.

text: 在这个价值体系下，本质上每个人都不是“人”，而是一些列可以量化估价的标签，没有人是值得的，“人”从来都不是关键因素，同样的标签，换成谁都一样。
en: Under this value system, essentially no one is a 'person' but rather a series of labels that can be quantified and priced. No one is worthy; 'person' is never the key factor — with the same labels, it makes no difference who is swapped in.

text: 不同的人就仿佛超市货架上的sku相同的两包方便面，拿哪一包都是一样。
en: Different people are like two packets of instant noodles sharing the same SKU on a supermarket shelf — whichever packet you take, it is the same.

text: 没有人最终能获得幸福，40岁的男人不会考虑同龄女，同样，40岁成功男人花重金娶到的18岁女孩也会因其破产或重病而离开。
en: No one ultimately gains happiness: a 40-year-old man will not consider a woman his own age; likewise, the 18-year-old girl a successful 40-year-old man marries for a fortune will leave him should he go bankrupt or fall gravely ill.

text: 大家都是商品，经济和生理属性变了或损坏了，就不再是同样的价值了，理应被抛弃。
en: Everyone is a commodity; once the economic or physiological attributes change or are damaged, they are no longer of the same value and ought to be cast aside.

text: 你最好卷死所有人爬到最顶端，用硬核价值赢得优秀伴侣，然后求祈求上天保佑你的人生别有任何低谷或意外。
en: You had best out-compete everyone to claw your way to the very top, win an excellent partner through hard-core value, and then pray to heaven that your life meets no trough or accident.

text: 国内这种思维几乎压倒式盛行，主要还是由于进入市场经济之后，人们开始重视价值，矫枉过正到了商品化包括自己在内的所有人，以及与其的关系，如婚姻。
en: Within the country this way of thinking prevails almost overwhelmingly, mainly because after entering a market economy people began to prize value, and overcorrected to the point of commodifying everyone including themselves, as well as their relationships with them, such as marriage.

text: 但最终，我们都是这种体系的受害者，包括被挑选和挑选他人的人。
en: But in the end we are all victims of this system, including both those who are chosen and those who choose others.

text: 很多人以为自己会是那个凌然人上的受益者，其实能够在这套恶性竞争机制的受益者极少，大概率我们都不是，我们的参与不过是白白消耗了自己。
en: Many believe they will be the beneficiary who towers above others; in truth very few can profit from this vicious competitive mechanism. Most likely we are not among them; our participation merely drains us for nothing.

text: 我直到三十多岁才认识到这点，也才明白我之前的执迷不悟。
en: I did not grasp this until my thirties, and only then understood my earlier stubborn delusion.

text: 以女性为例，想通过这种体系进入争夺优秀男性的资格，你要么个人综合条件一般加上家境极好，要么极其优秀且漂亮，其余的基本盘根本入不了高端局。
en: Take women as an example: to gain, through this system, the qualification to compete for excellent men, you must either have merely average all-round personal conditions coupled with an extremely good family background, or be exceptionally excellent and beautiful. The rest of the basic pool simply cannot enter the high-end game.

text: 我在每个年龄都几乎优秀程度和硬件美丽综合分数都已经站在金字塔的顶端，前5%的存在，身高颜值肤色学历工作，甚至情商教养魅男程度（愿意卑躬屈膝和舔狗讨好）都挑不出任何问题，即使加上家境的debuff，也是前10%。
en: At every age my combined score of excellence and physical beauty has stood at the apex of the pyramid — among the top 5 per cent: height, looks, skin, education, career, even emotional intelligence, upbringing, and ability to charm men (a willingness to bow and scrape and fawn as a simp) — all beyond reproach. Even with the debuff of family background added, I remain in the top 10 per cent.

text: 普通女性根本都没有进入这场恶性竞争，争夺所谓优质男的资格。
en: Ordinary women simply never enter this vicious competition, lacking the qualification to vie for so-called high-quality men.

text: 你想收益于这个竞争，你至少要综合碾压我或家境极好来入场。
en: To benefit from this competition, you must at least crush me outright in every respect, or come from an extremely good family, just to get in.

text: 我作为一个勉强有入场券资格的优秀漂亮女性但家境一般的佼佼者。
en: I, an outstanding and beautiful excellent woman who only barely holds an entrance ticket, yet comes from an ordinary family.

text: 这么多年，也无法在这种残酷的系统中得到任何收益，年轻时，被嫌弃不够优秀有钱，年龄大了有财富了，被嫌弃其他，那些愿意给我橄榄枝的人，我清楚一旦我的任何方面走下坡路，便会抛弃我，这种利用的橄榄枝我闭着眼睛也没法逼着自己接，我无法接受我的婚姻的质量如此低劣，我交不出这份他人看着的标准答案，实际是一辈子的吃shi。
en: All these years I have gained not the slightest benefit from this cruel system. When young, I was despised as not excellent or wealthy enough; older, with wealth, I was despised for other things. Those who extended an olive branch to me — I know that the moment any aspect of me declined, they would abandon me. I could not, even with my eyes shut, force myself to accept this utilitarian olive branch. I cannot accept that the quality of my marriage would be so base. I cannot hand in this standard answer that others gaze upon; it is in truth a lifetime of eating shit.

text: 这场博弈没有最终的赢家，因利益而聚，必因利益而散。
en: This contest has no ultimate winner: gathered for interest, it must scatter for interest.

text: 两端的人以此作为婚姻的基石并无问题，底层求生存的人，和上层的大家贵族，都有对生存足够巨大的利益去让婚姻长久持续。
en: Those at both ends taking this as the cornerstone of marriage is no problem: the people at the bottom who struggle merely to survive, and the great noble houses at the top, both have interests weighty enough for survival to sustain a marriage over the long term.

text: 可是广大中产并没有，中产才是这种有毒思维的最大受害者。
en: Yet the vast middle class does not; the middle class is the greatest victim of this toxic mindset.

text: 我们中产本应是最自由的阶层，可以寻找接近灵魂伴侣的美好婚姻，可是却往往固步自封，为了上层人给我们设置的标准答案婚姻家庭而荒废了一生，真的可悲。
en: We of the middle class ought to be the freest class, able to seek a fine marriage close to a soulmate; yet we often shut ourselves in, squandering our lives on the standard-answer family and marriage set for us by those above — truly deplorable.

text: 我不想再可悲的活着，从此是我的新生。
en: I do not wish to go on living so deplorably; from here on is my rebirth.

text: ——致我对婚姻标准答案的执念，希望那份执念永远被埋葬，烟消云散，还我自由和人性。
en: —— To my obsession with the standard answer of marriage: may that obsession be buried forever, dissolve like smoke and cloud, and return to me my freedom and humanity.

text: 个人感觉有以下两种原因:
en: Personally, I feel there are the following two reasons:

text: 1.是身体原因，女人到了四十岁，身体确实不如二十几岁的小姑娘，不管承认不承认，现实就是这样，各项机能都在下降，有些身体不好的，情况会更严重。
en: 1. It is a matter of the body: a woman at forty is indeed not as fit as a girl in her twenties; whether one admits it or not, reality is just so — every function is in decline, and for those in poor health the situation is more severe.

text: 还有就是，四岁的男人既然还想找老婆，就是还想生孩子，传宗接代，或者是考虑养老的问题，这是不可避免的，但是四十岁的女人生孩子，不是不能生，只是有危险，还有一种现在，孩子的成长问题，四十多岁生孩子，男女年龄都不小了，到六十多岁的时候，孩子才十几岁，还没能力在社会上生存，甚至还在校园里，万一两人运气不好，有个什么闪失，孩子怎么办呢？
en: Moreover, since a forty-year-old man who still wants to find a wife still wishes to have children, to carry on the family line, or is weighing the question of care in old age — this is unavoidable. But for a forty-year-old woman to bear children, it is not that she cannot, only that there is risk; and there is also the matter of the child's upbringing. Having a child in one's forties, both man and woman are no longer young; by the time they are in their sixties the child is only in their teens, not yet able to make a living in society, perhaps still at school. Should the two of them have the ill luck to meet with some mishap, what would become of the child?

text: 2.这个原因就比较现实了，有能力的男人四十岁左右的年纪是不缺女人的，他们有能力，有财富，这些不需要女人来提供，还能反馈给女人，二十多岁的小姑娘往身上扑，没必要找四十岁的。
en: 2. This reason is the more worldly one: capable men around forty are never short of women. They have ability and wealth, which they need not obtain from a woman and can even give back to her; twenty-something girls throw themselves at them, so there is no need to seek out a forty-year-old.

text: 虽然感觉这样的男人很肤浅，但现实就是这样。
en: Though such men seem rather shallow, reality is just so.

text: 反过来，四十岁的男人没结过婚，或者离婚了的，本身条件一般，他考虑四十岁的女人，人家也不一定会考虑他。
en: Conversely, a forty-year-old man who has never married, or is divorced, with only average conditions himself — even should he consider a forty-year-old woman, she may not necessarily consider him.

text: 如果考虑过平凡的人生，就不会等到四十岁结婚了。
en: Had one contemplated an ordinary life, one would not have waited until forty to marry.

text: 既然等了，心里那道坎就过不去。
en: Since one has waited, that hurdle in the heart cannot be crossed.

text: 而且普通男人根本什么都提供不了，高质量的生活没有，情绪价值也没有，而且这个年龄了，谁都不是，都不想付出，只想空手套白狼，所以自私自利是免不了的，甚至还想从女人身上获得点儿东西。
en: Moreover, ordinary men can provide nothing at all — no high-quality life, nor emotional value either. And at this age no one is anyone; no one wants to give, all only wish to catch a wolf with bare hands, so selfishness is unavoidable — they even want to gain something from the woman.

text: 所以，不要把四十岁的女人看的太可怜，人家说不定过的很潇洒呢？
en: So do not view forty-year-old women as too pitiable; they may well be living quite freely and dashingly, you know?
